Ui.Script:
BenillaAssist = { seen = {} }
function BenillaAssist_On(cvar) return GetCVar(cvar) ~= "0" end
-- ── What a finger is on (the touch layer asks as it lands) ── -- Names, as the stock interface makes them; an addon's own bag looks plain. BENILLA_MOBILE_ITEM_FRAMES = { "^ContainerFrame%d+Item%d+$", "^Character%a+Slot$", "^BankFrameItem%d+$", "^MerchantItem%d+ItemButton$", "^MerchantBuyBackItemItemButton$", } BENILLA_MOBILE_SPELL_FRAMES = { "^SpellButton%d+$" } BENILLA_MOBILE_ACTION_FRAMES = { "^ActionButton%d+$", "^BonusActionButton%d+$", "^MultiBar%a+Button%d+$", "^BenillaMobileRingSlot%d+$", "^PetActionButton%d+$", "^ShapeshiftButton%d+$", }
local function BenillaAssist_Matches(name, patterns) for _, p in ipairs(patterns) do if string.find(name, p) then return 1 end end end
-- "item", "spell", "action" or "plain". With something on the cursor every frame is plain: -- a tap puts it down. function BenillaMobile_TouchKind() if not BenillaAssist_On("mobileItemGestures") then return "plain" end if CursorHasItem() or CursorHasSpell() then return "plain" end local focus = GetMouseFocus() local name = focus and focus:GetName() if not name then return "plain" end if BenillaAssist_Matches(name, BENILLA_MOBILE_ITEM_FRAMES) then return "item" end if BenillaAssist_Matches(name, BENILLA_MOBILE_SPELL_FRAMES) then return "spell" end if BenillaAssist_Matches(name, BENILLA_MOBILE_ACTION_FRAMES) then return "action" end return "plain" end
-- ── Haptics ── function BenillaAssist_Haptic(kind, style) if not BenillaAssist_On("mobileHaptics") or not BenillaAssist_On(kind) then return end -- Never two within a breath: a flurry of hits is one thump. local now = GetTime() if BenillaAssist.hapticAt and now - BenillaAssist.hapticAt < 0.12 then return end BenillaAssist.hapticAt = now BenillaMobile_Haptic(style) end
-- ── Smart targeting: an action the game refused for want of an enemy target goes again -- at the nearest enemy, once ── BENILLA_MOBILE_NO_TARGET_ERRORS = {} for _, key in ipairs({ "ERR_GENERIC_NO_TARGET", "SPELL_FAILED_BAD_TARGETS", "SPELL_FAILED_BAD_IMPLICIT_TARGETS", "SPELL_FAILED_TARGETS_DEAD", "SPELL_FAILED_TARGET_FRIENDLY", "ERR_INVALID_ATTACK_TARGET" }) do local text = getglobal(key) if text then BENILLA_MOBILE_NO_TARGET_ERRORS[text] = 1 end end
local BenillaAssist_UseAction = UseAction function UseAction(slot, checkCursor, onSelf) BenillaAssist.action = slot BenillaAssist.actionAt = GetTime() BenillaAssist.actionSelf = onSelf BenillaAssist.retried = nil BenillaAssist_Haptic("mobileHapticButtons", "light") return BenillaAssist_UseAction(slot, checkCursor, onSelf) end
local BenillaAssist_Jump = Jump function Jump() BenillaAssist_Haptic("mobileHapticButtons", "light") return BenillaAssist_Jump() end
function BenillaAssist_OnError(message) if not BenillaAssist_On("mobileSmartTarget") or BenillaAssist.retried then return end if not BenillaAssist.action or BenillaAssist.actionSelf then return end if GetTime() - (BenillaAssist.actionAt or 0) > 0.5 then return end if not BENILLA_MOBILE_NO_TARGET_ERRORS[message] then return end BenillaAssist.retried = 1 TargetNearestEnemy() if UnitExists("target") and UnitCanAttack("player", "target") then BenillaAssist_UseAction(BenillaAssist.action) end end
-- ── Combat haptics: a big hit, low health, a pull, a death ── function BenillaAssist_OnHealth() local hp, max = UnitHealth("player"), UnitHealthMax("player") if not max or max <= 0 then return end local last = BenillaAssist.health BenillaAssist.health = hp if last and hp < last and not UnitIsDeadOrGhost("player") then local drop = (last - hp) / max if drop >= 0.3 then BenillaAssist_Haptic("mobileHapticCombat", "heavy") elseif drop >= 0.12 then BenillaAssist_Haptic("mobileHapticCombat", "medium") end end if hp / max < 0.3 and hp > 0 then if not BenillaAssist.lowWarned then BenillaAssist.lowWarned = 1 BenillaAssist.hapticAt = nil BenillaAssist_Haptic("mobileHapticCombat", "warning") end elseif hp / max > 0.45 then BenillaAssist.lowWarned = nil end end
-- ── The context button ── function BenillaMobileContext_Wanted() return BENILLA_MOBILE_CONTEXT_VERB and BenillaAssist_On("mobileContextButton") end
function BenillaMobileContext_Update() local b = BenillaMobileContextButton if BENILLA_MOBILE_CONTEXT_VERB then BenillaMobileRound_SetIcon(b, BENILLA_MOBILE_CONTEXT_ICON) BenillaMobileContextButtonLabel:SetText(BENILLA_MOBILE_CONTEXT_VERB) end if BenillaMobile_Apply then BenillaMobile_Apply() end end
-- ── The safe area: the interface kept clear of the Dynamic Island, the corners and the -- home indicator, as iOS reports them; the world still fills the screen ── function BenillaMobileSafe_Insets() local s = BENILLA_MOBILE_SAFE if not s or not BenillaAssist_On("mobileSafeArea") then return 0, 0, 0, 0 end local w, h = GetScreenWidth(), GetScreenHeight() return s.left * w, s.right * w, s.top * h, s.bottom * h end
function BenillaMobileSafe_Apply() local l, r, t, b = BenillaMobileSafe_Insets() local key = string.format("%.1f,%.1f,%.1f,%.1f", l, r, t, b) if BenillaAssist.seen.safe == key then return end BenillaAssist.seen.safe = key UIParent:ClearAllPoints() UIParent:SetPoint("TOPLEFT", nil, "TOPLEFT", l, -t) UIParent:SetPoint("BOTTOMRIGHT", nil, "BOTTOMRIGHT", -r, b) -- The touch controls keep their own places on the whole screen. if BenillaMobile_Apply then BenillaMobile_Apply() end end
-- The options window fits the safe area, not the whole screen. function BenillaOptionsFrame_UpdateScale() local l, r, t, b = BenillaMobileSafe_Insets() local k = BENILLA_ERA_WINDOW_SCALE local wFit = (GetScreenWidth() - l - r) / 940 local hFit = (GetScreenHeight() - t - b) / 744 if wFit < k then k = wFit end if hFit < k then k = hFit end BenillaOptionsFrame:SetScale(k) end
-- The assists' CVars the options page writes, read back each half second. function BenillaAssist_Poll() for _, name in ipairs({ "mobileSafeArea", "mobileContextButton" }) do local v = GetCVar(name) if BenillaAssist.seen[name] ~= v then BenillaAssist.seen[name] = v if name == "mobileSafeArea" then BenillaMobileSafe_Apply() elseif BenillaMobile_Apply then BenillaMobile_Apply() end end end -- A new UI scale moves the insets in UIParent's units. BenillaMobileSafe_Apply() end

Scripts.OnEvent: if event == "UI_ERROR_MESSAGE" then BenillaAssist_OnError(arg1) elseif event == "UNIT_HEALTH" then if arg1 == "player" then BenillaAssist_OnHealth() end elseif event == "PLAYER_REGEN_DISABLED" then BenillaAssist_Haptic("mobileHapticCombat", "medium") elseif event == "PLAYER_DEAD" then BenillaAssist.hapticAt = nil BenillaAssist_Haptic("mobileHapticCombat", "error") elseif event == "PLAYER_ENTERING_WORLD" then BenillaAssist.health = nil BenillaAssist.seen = {} BenillaAssist_Poll() end
Scripts.OnUpdate: this.elapsed = this.elapsed + arg1 if this.elapsed > 0.5 then this.elapsed = 0 BenillaAssist_Poll() end

Scripts.OnClick: if BenillaMobile.editing then BenillaMobileLayout_Select(this.elementId) return end BenillaAssist_Haptic("mobileHapticButtons", "light") BenillaMobile_ContextUse()
